## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type

- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Scientific-model change
- [ ] Release or packaging change

## Validation

Explain how the change was checked.

## Scientific assumptions

List any biological assumptions, simplifications, or evidence changes. Write “Not applicable” when none apply.

## Checklist

- [ ] I reviewed existing issues and documentation.
- [ ] I did not include private or patient-identifiable information.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation.
- [ ] I separated validated behavior from hypotheses or approximations.
